meta.name: animate
meta.description: Animate app and web UIs across Flutter, React, SwiftUI, Compose, and React Native with motion systems, guardrails, and reduced-motion fallbacks.

copy.tagline: 为多平台 UI 添加流畅动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同平台上为应用界面添加精美动画
copy.tagline_en: Animate UIs smoothly across multiple platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add polished animations to app UIs across different platforms

howto.what: 当你说出与动效相关的需求时，Claude 会帮你制定动效方案、选择技术实现，并给出可测试的验收标准，支持 Flutter、React、SwiftUI、Compose 和 React Native 等框架。
howto.when: 当你需要为产品 UI 设计或实现微交互、导航过渡、共享元素动画、加载状态、手势反馈或动效系统时。

say.text: 帮我为 Flutter 的登录页面添加一个淡入淡出的过渡。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的动效合同和代码片段。

say.text: 在 React Native 中实现一个共享元素动画，从列表跳转到详情页。
say.note: Claude 会匹配平台最佳抽象并给出示例。

say.text: 设计一个减少运动模式的回退方案，尊重系统设置。
say.note: Claude 会确保动效符合可访问性要求。

howto.what_en: When you describe motion needs, Claude helps you craft motion contracts, choose stack-specific implementations, and define testable acceptance criteria for Flutter, React, SwiftUI, Compose, React Native, and other web stacks.
howto.when_en: When you need to design or implement micro-interactions, navigation transitions, shared-element flows, loading states, gesture feedback, or motion systems in product UIs.

say_en.text: Add a fade-in transition to the login page in Flutter.
say_en.note: Claude generates a motion contract and code snippet.

say_en.text: Implement a shared-element animation from a list to a detail screen in React Native.
say_en.note: Claude routes to the safest native abstraction with examples.

say_en.text: Design a reduced-motion fallback respecting system settings.
